title: Per-model quantization defaults: recommended profiles and guardrails
creator: Aisha Khatri
description: Goal: Add per-model quantization default profiles to the model catalog and ship a calibration + accuracy-validation workflow so that customers get safe, cost-saving defaults out-of-the-box. Scope: 1) Define a small set of recommended default profiles (FP8, INT8 variants, plus a safe FP16 fallback) mapped by model archetype and size. 2) Implement a calibration pipeline that runs during model onboarding that computes activation scales/statistics using a representative calibration dataset and produces a calibration artifact. 3) Add model-catalog metadata fields: default_quant_profile, calibration_artifact_link, expected_accuracy_delta, and guardrail_flags. 4) Build automated accuracy validation checks (metrics, thresholds, smoke tests) used to accept or reject a default profile. Out of scope: quantization-aware retraining and runtime-only dynamic quant schemes. Constraints/Trade-offs: - Must avoid increasing inference latency beyond SLO thresholds for dedicated and hosted tiers. - Guardrails must prioritize quality: a recommended profile should not be allowed if accuracy delta > threshold on validation prompts. - Calibration runs must be bounded in cost/time (target: <= 30 minutes per medium-sized model on a single GPU). Deliverables: PRD doc with profile mapping, calibration pipeline code and CI job, model-catalog schema migration, dashboard tiles showing accuracy deltas and rollout history, automated gating rule for console rollouts.
acceptance_criteria: Catalog: new per-model metadata fields exist and can be populated during onboarding
Profiles: a canonical mapping table exists that recommends FP8/INT8/FP16 defaults per archetype
Calibration: onboarding pipeline produces a calibration artifact (scales/statistics) and stores a checksum link
Validation: automated accuracy validation runs produce metrics (perplexity/EM/embedding-cosine) and compare to baseline with configurable thresholds
Guardrails: if validation fails, the default profile is marked 'blocked' and fallback to FP16 recommended
Console: rollout UI surfaces quantization profile, expected accuracy delta, and 'accept/reject' action
Telemetry: quantized runs report latency and token cost deltas compared to baseline
updates: 2026-02-14: Kickoff meeting with Research and Runtime teams. Agreed canonical archetypes: decoder-small, decoder-large, encoder-decoder, embedding-only.

2026-02-20: Research provided initial profile recommendations: decoder-small -> INT8 asymmetric + per-channel scales; decoder-large -> FP8 hybrid profile with FP16 keys; encoder-decoder -> INT8 w/ outlier clipping; embedding-only -> INT8 calibrated. Draft stored at https://confluence.redwood.ai/quant-profiles-draft

2026-02-28: Prototype calibration pipeline (calib-run v0) completed. Uses 5k representative samples, collects activation histograms and per-tensor min/max and computes per-channel scales. Runtime integration PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/2345

2026-03-04: Validation harness added to CI; runs baseline FP16 inference and each candidate quant profile; computes metrics: perplexity, top-k accuracy, and embedding cosine. Baseline thresholds for acceptance set to: perplexity delta <= 2%, embedding cosine >= 0.995, top-k accuracy delta <= 1%.

2026-03-10: Discovered edge case with LoRA adapters where per-channel INT8 produced >3% perplexity regression on long-context tests. Interim decision: mark LoRA-attached models as 'QA required' and default to FP16 for catalog until adapter-aware calibration added.
2026-03-12: UX mockups for catalog exposure and rollout gating added to Confluence. PM review scheduled 2026-03-16.
2026-03-14: Integration tests flaky on embedder models; investigating calibration sample representativeness. Assigned to Maya Lopez for dataset selection and augmentation guidance.
implementation_notes: Implementation plan: 1) Add model-catalog schema fields as strings (default_quant_profile, calibration_artifact_link, expected_accuracy_delta, guardrail_flags). 2) Hook onboarding pipeline to run calib-run with a representative dataset; store artifact in durable storage and surface link. 3) Run automated validation comparing quantized output to FP16 baseline using a small curated prompt set + embedding probe. 4) Expose draft profile and validation results in Console; provide 'approve' button to make default active. Safety net: if validation fails or if model flagged (LoRA, very long context), default to FP16 and add a ticket to perform adapter-aware calibration.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Calibration dataset not representative -> false acceptance. Mitigation: require at least two independent representative sets and human spot-check for new model families.
Risk: Increased onboarding cost/time. Mitigation: cap calibration job to N GPUs/time budget and provide opt-out with manual review for enterprise customers.

Risk: Regressions in downstream metrics (e.g., hallucinations) not captured by automatic metrics. Mitigation: add targeted human evals for high-risk models and a rollback policy linked to Console rollouts.

Risk: Runtime incompatibilities between FP8 kernels across HW. Mitigation: profile kernels at onboarding and only publish FP8 defaults if runtime verified on at least two target device families; otherwise default INT8 or FP16.
